ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels to 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones occupy the medial and distal regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black borders are present along the trailing and lateral edges. A significant dark pigmentation encroachment is located at the central notch and peduncle connection. Distinct low-intensity focal spots are visible within the white fields of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a wide calculated pixel angle and moderate bounding-box depth relative to overall lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous linear boundary exhibits irregular micro-topography with frequent low-amplitude peaks and valleys (serrations) along the trailing edge of both lobes, isolated from the background water pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges of both lobes follow a convex mathematical curve, sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of small, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters located in the inner-medial region of the right lobe white field and the mid-medial region of the left lobe white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple, distinct, unaligned linear low-intensity pixel disruptions (diagonal rake marks) that break the high-intensity white field on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of three prominent diagonal linear scars on the left lobe and small circular focal scars on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Irregular jagged encroachment of black pigmentation from the trailing edge into the white fields, particularly concentrated near the median notch and the distal tips.
